title: Purple Ledger Nano X in a video shared by @kryptodegeny

components: Flat antenna taped between the battery and the LTE module, with a fine feed wire and solder pad
LTE module, MCU and SIM, hidden under the antenna tape
Main board wrapped in yellow Kapton tape
Replacement battery with a yellow flex tail
implant.notes: An 88-second video of a purple Nano X being taken apart on a workbench, posted by a Polish crypto account as commentary on the implant reports. Mark Karpelès (@MagicalTux) identified it on 14 Oct 2026 as a Gen 2 implant, the same build as Tibane Labs' Specimen A. The black part on the battery is the flat antenna tape, laid between the battery and the LTE module, and it hides the MCU and the SIM. The main board is wrapped in yellow Kapton tape. The device still boots to Ledger's onboarding screen. The post doesn't say who filmed the video, or where the device was bought.

sources.author: Krypto Degeneraci.
sources.text:
KUPUJESZ LEDGERA, A W ŚRODKU MASZ PODSŁUCH, KTÓRY KRADNIE TWOJE BITCOINY

Badacze rozebrali zmodyfikowane Ledger Nano X i znaleźli w środku dodatkową elektronikę z modemem LTE i kartą SIM.

I teraz najlepsze. Ten mały skurczybyk potrafi przechwycić 24 słowa seeda wyświetlane…

(Polish: "You buy a Ledger, and inside there's a bug that steals your bitcoins. Researchers took apart modified Ledger Nano X units and found extra electronics inside, with an LTE modem and a SIM card. And now the best part: this little rascal can intercept the 24 seed words displayed…")

images.caption: Still from the video at 1:12: the OLED side of the board (left), and the battery (right) with the flat antenna tape and its feed wire laid over the LTE module, hiding the MCU and the SIM.
Still at 0:23: the main board wrapped in yellow Kapton tape, next to the battery.
Still at 1:15: the opened device still boots to Ledger's onboarding screen.

videos.caption: The full 88-second video, 1080p as posted. The original filmer is not credited.
